messages:
lina: quick thread — finalizing Wed webinar run and rehearsal schedule. Need one-line abstracts, demo fallback plan, and lead-routing mapping by EOD.
arjun: order proposal: intro (lina) -> platform narrative (arjun) -> benchmarks (claire) -> live demo (tom) -> q&a. 40m + 15m.
claire: i'll condense benchmark takeaways into 3 slides and include a screenshot fallback.
tom: demo fallback plan: primary=dedicated pool, fallback=hosted-quantized endpoint, visual fallback=recorded GIF. will prepare both.
lina: lead routing: if attend_type=enterprise -> sdr-abm; company_size>500 -> sdr-enterprise; interest=private_trial -> partner-engage. map to HubSpot properties before launch.
arjun: CTA AB test: CTA-A="Request cost review" -> sales-opps, CTA-B="Apply for private trial" -> partner-engage. We'll test ad variations.
claire: rehearsal slots: tech canary Tue 10am PT, full run Wed 9am PT. canary owner = me.
lina: ops notes: pre-warm KV cache at T-1m, pre-spin +1 GPU at T-5m in us-west-2, captions ON. ops-bot schedule reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: tech canary Tue 10:00am PT.
tom: i'll add a 60s warmup step in the run-of-show and a short troubleshooting slide (5 bullets) for the panel.
arjun: marketing copy: highlight "predictable inference economics" + "same API across deployment modes". keep social captions <240 chars.
lina: action items: tom upload demo GIF + fallback slide, claire share benchmark screenshots, arjun prepare ad captions, i'll publish HubSpot mapping and lock plan at EOD. :lock:
